brief:
Pro-Palestine supporters demonstrated outside an Israeli real estate marketing event in New York on Tuesday, objecting to the promotion of properties in West Bank settlements, Shehab Wire reported. Police arrested several protesters during the action.

The event promoted land sales in settlements across occupied Palestinian territory. Organizers of the demonstration said the real estate marketing violated international law prohibiting the transfer of civilian populations into occupied areas.

title: Pro-Palestine activists protest Israeli real estate event in New York
